name: Autlantic Billing for WooCommerce
author: Autlantic

sections.description:
Autlantic Billing for WooCommerce adds a payment gateway so your store can accept USDC on Base through Autlantic hosted checkout.

Buyers leave your cart, pay on Autlantic, and return after payment. Signed webhooks update the WooCommerce order. Settlement goes to your merchant payout wallet. Autlantic does not custody checkout funds.

What you get

  • One-time checkout via a single-use Autlantic payment link and hosted checkout
  • Signed webhooks that mark orders paid, with recent deliveries on the gateway settings screen
  • Test connection so you can verify your API key against the Autlantic catalog before going live
  • Cart and Checkout blocks, plus High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Optional WooCommerce Subscriptions for week, month, or year plans (create, cancel, and record renewals from Autlantic)

Requirements

  • WooCommerce active (Requires Plugins: woocommerce)
  • Store currency USD or USDC
  • An Autlantic merchant API key (abk_test_… or abk_live_…) and a webhook signing secret from the merchant portal

Documentation

  • Commerce guide: https://docs.autlantic.com/guide/commerce
  • Webhooks: https://docs.autlantic.com/guide/webhooks
  • Merchant portal: https://portal.autlantic.com
  • Support: support@autlantic.com

Refunds

Invoice refunds work when an Autlantic invoice id is stored on the order. One-time payment-link checkouts do not offer automated refunds through the billing API yet. Handle those manually in your process.

External services

This plugin connects to Autlantic Billing (hosted API and checkout on billing.autlantic.com / Autlantic infrastructure) to create payment links, verify webhook signatures, test API keys, and optionally manage subscription renewals.

Data sent to Autlantic typically includes order identifiers, amounts, currency, line-item labels needed for checkout, and customer contact details required to complete payment. Webhook events are received by your WordPress site so order status can update.

  • Terms: https://autlantic.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://autlantic.com/privacy
  • Security: https://autlantic.com/security
  • Docs: https://docs.autlantic.com

You must create an Autlantic merchant account and configure API credentials in WooCommerce settings for the gateway to work.
sections.installation:
1. Install from Plugins → Add New, or upload the plugin zip / copy autlantic-billing-for-woocommerce into wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Autlantic Billing for WooCommerce. WooCommerce must already be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Autlantic Billing.
  4. Paste your API key (abk_test_… or abk_live_…) and webhook signing secret.

  5. In the Autlantic merchant portal, register this webhook URL (use HTTPS on production):

    https://your-store.example/wp-json/autlantic/v1/webhook

  6. Click Test connection, then place a test order with a test API key before switching to live.

Use the portal Test webhook endpoint with a test key, and the Live endpoint with a live key.
sections.faq:
Does this replace the PHP SDK?

No. The plugin uses the official autlantic/billing PHP client. The WordPress.org zip vendors that client so the store does not need Composer.

Do I need WooCommerce Subscriptions?

No. One-time checkout works without it. Install WooCommerce Subscriptions only if you sell week, month, or year plans. Other billing intervals are not supported.

Where do funds settle?

To the merchant payout wallet configured in the Autlantic portal, or the optional payout address in the gateway settings. Autlantic does not custody the payment.

How do Test and Live modes work?

API keys determine mode: abk_test_… for test, abk_live_… for live. Register matching webhook endpoints and secrets in the portal for each mode.

Where can I read the full docs?

https://docs.autlantic.com/guide/commerce

How do I get support?

Email support@autlantic.com or open a topic on the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.3

  • Use WordPress HTTP API for billing requests (no curl in the WP.org package).
  • Enqueue admin tools script; Requires Plugins: woocommerce; clean activation.
  • HMAC permission_callback on webhook REST route; preserve empty secret fields.

1.1.2

  • Enqueue admin tools script via wp_enqueue_script.
  • Add Requires Plugins: woocommerce.
  • Activate without wp_die when WooCommerce is missing.
  • Authorize webhook REST route with HMAC permission_callback.

1.1.1

  • Uninstall removes the webhook activity log.

1.1.0

  • Merchant tools: live/test badge, test connection, webhook activity, and order sync.
  • Checkout and settings use the Autlantic mark and wordmark.
  • Subscriptions support is limited to create, cancel, and renewal recording.

1.0.0

  • Initial gateway: one-time checkout, webhooks, refunds, optional WooCommerce Subscriptions, blocks checkout.
